criterion.definition: A current official nationwide six-digit assignment denominator must reconcile one-to-one with a fixed official 4-72/MINTIC Polygon source under written reusable rights. A deterministic, topology-valid Polygon/MultiPolygon display artifact derived only by documented simplification may serve the real CO API and app when it preserves every assignment and exposes derived provenance, source dates, confidence and geometry type. Expanded postcodes, sites, properties, addresses, buildings, P.O. boxes, organizations, routes, administrative boundaries, buffers, models and AGID cells are excluded and receive no invented area. The app must normalize six digits, handle loading, no-match, multiple, API failure and invalid geometry, fit the selected area, render a translucent fill and clear outline, clear and re-search, and display selected code, geometry type, official/derived/virtual class, source, reference date and confidence.

sources.finding: Official viewer links the national postal-code download, national shape download and open licence, and distinguishes CodigoPostal from CodigoPostalAmpliado.

sources.finding: Decimal-number export is reversibly normalized as whole-part padded to three digits plus fractional-part padded to three digits; the result is 3,681 distinct valid six-digit codes, 1,395 urban and 2,286 rural.
3,681 official Polygon features, 3,681 distinct valid six-digit codes, zero duplicate codes, zero empty or OGR-invalid geometries and an exact code-set match to the 2025 assignment dataset.

sources.finding: The service separates layer 0 CodigoPostalAmpliado from layer 1 CodigoPostal and declares EPSG:4326.

Layer 1 is esriGeometryPolygon, supports GeoJSON query and exposes Codigo_Postal. Current item metadata has no all-rights-reserved licence text; the government catalog and viewer clause establish the reusable artifact path.

3,681 distinct six-digit records; the date fields are null, so source freshness is taken from the government dataset metadata and the older geometry date remains explicit rather than being overwritten.

geometryValidation.transform: GDAL 3.12.1 ogr2ogr RFC7946; EPSG:4326; simplify-preserve-topology tolerance 0.001 degrees; make-valid; coordinate precision 6; builder extracts only area components

rightsConclusion.basis: The official government catalog applies CC BY-SA 4.0 to the national dataset, directly identifies 4-72 and links the exact shape archive; the same official viewer links that archive beside an open clause expressly permitting redistribution and transformation.

conclusion: The current nationwide assignment denominator, reusable rights and official Polygon source satisfy the CO source gate. The published AGID geometry is explicitly derived display context because it is simplified and the source geometry date remains 2016; no official-boundary freshness beyond the 2025 exact code-set reconciliation is claimed.
